title: 第11章 我这是正当防卫第12章 今生我赐予你一场造化
lines: “咳咳咳，放，放我下来。”
“晨哥，救，救我，咳咳咳……”
许杰被掐住咽喉，双腿无助的挣扎，面色涨得通红。
唐明淡淡开口：“我上午就说过，随时欢迎你的报复，只要你能承受相应的后果。”
“但这个后果，你怕是承受不住。”
话落地，他掐着许杰就朝着墙壁撞过去。
嘭！
嘭！
嘭！
一下、两下、三下……
许杰痛苦嚎叫，好不容易包扎好的伤口在，再次迸裂流出鲜血。
“草泥马的，还敢动手！”
樊晨等人大惊，领着钢管等武器冲上来。
“来得好。”
唐明丝毫不惧，将奄奄一息的许杰丢在地上，反身冲入人群中。
与此同时，附中校门外，一行人漫步而出。
陈思琪看向一名英俊男生：“赵鹏，待会就辛苦你了，你和樊晨那些人认识，有你出面，他们肯定不会乱来的。”
“呵呵，放心吧。”
赵鹏搂着女友田雯雯，淡笑道：“樊晨这人欺软怕硬，上次被我教训过，我过去，他屁都不敢多放一个。”
“你既然是雯雯的闺蜜，自然也是我赵鹏的好朋友，有困难肯定帮忙。”
他身高一米八，剑眉星目很是英俊，而且身上穿的衣服全是国际名牌，手腕上带着瑞士金表，豪气逼人。
田雯雯抱着男友的胳膊，笑眯眯道：“还是我家赵鹏厉害，比那个什么瘸子唐明厉害一百倍。”
“就你小嘴最甜。”
赵鹏拍了拍她的小脸蛋，接着看向陈思琪：“对了思琪，那个唐明和你是什么关系？”
“他……他是我一个远方亲戚，我妈和他妈妈是闺蜜，他家里出了变故所以住我家。”
“其实我都烦死了，他来我家，我妈对他照顾有加，我都没这种待遇。”
陈思琪苦恼开口。
赵鹏提了个建议：“既然你讨厌他，要不我们慢点过去吧，给他点教训也好，放心，有我在不会出什么事的。”
陈思琪有些犹豫，但毕竟有助于人家，她也不好多说什么。
而这时，田雯雯突然问道：“对了莉莉，雨柔今天怎么没和我们一起，不是说好赵鹏请喝奶茶吗？”
另一名高个子女生回应：“雨柔说她有点急事，就先走了。”
content_en:
"Cough cough cough, put it down, put me down."
"Brother Chen, save, save me, cough cough cough..."
Xu Jie was choked, his legs struggled helplessly, and his face turned red.
Tang Ming said calmly: "I said this morning that you are welcome to retaliate at any time, as long as you can bear the corresponding consequences."
"But I'm afraid you won't be able to bear the consequences."
As soon as he finished speaking, he pinched Xu Jie and ran towards the wall.
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Once, twice, three times...
Xu Jie howled in pain, and the wound that was finally bandaged burst open again and oozed blood.
"You idiot, you dare to take action!"
Fan Chen and others were shocked and rushed forward with steel pipes and other weapons.
"Well come."
Tang Ming was not afraid at all. He threw the dying Xu Jie to the ground and rushed into the crowd.
…
At the same time, a group of people strolled out outside the gate of the attached high school.
Chen Siqi looked at a handsome boy: "Zhao Peng, I'll thank you later. You know Fan Chen and the others, and with your help, they will definitely not mess around."
"Haha, don't worry."
Zhao Peng hugged his girlfriend Tian Wenwen and said with a smile: "Fan Chen bullies the weak and fears the strong. I taught him a lesson last time. When I went over, he didn't dare to let go of one more thing."
"Since you are Wenwen's best friend, you are naturally also a good friend of mine, Zhao Peng. If you have any difficulties, you will definitely help me."
He is 1.8 meters tall, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes. He is very handsome, and the clothes he wears are all international brands. He wears a Swiss gold watch on his wrist, which makes him look proud.
Tian Wenwen hugged her boyfriend's arm and said with a smile: "My Zhao Peng is still better, a hundred times better than that lame Tang Ming."
"Your little mouth is the sweetest."
Zhao Peng patted her little face, then looked at Chen Siqi: "By the way, Siqi, what is the relationship between Tang Ming and you?"
"He...he is a distant relative of mine. My mother and his mother are best friends. Something happened in his family, so he stayed at my house."
"Actually, I'm annoyed to death. He comes to my house and my mother takes good care of him, but I don't get the same treatment."
Chen Siqi spoke in distress.
Zhao Peng made a suggestion: "Since you hate him, why don't we go there slowly and teach him a lesson? Don't worry, nothing will happen to him as long as I'm here."
"This..."
Chen Siqi was a little hesitant, but after all, it was helpful to others, so she couldn't say much.
At this time, Tian Wenwen suddenly asked: "By the way Lily, why is Yurou not with us today? Didn't you agree that Zhao Peng would treat you to milk tea?"
Another tall girl responded: "Yu Rou said she was in a hurry and left first."
